cells.name: Headframe
cells.description: Overhead: the shaft's headframe, a lattice frame round all four sides with corner towers and two sheave wheels; open in the middle so the shaft shows through. Drawn above units.

cells.name: Print gantry
cells.description: Overhead: a print gantry over its bed, rails north and south, its bridge and head across the middle. Drawn above units.

cells.name: Proving torus
cells.description: The great proving torus at the field hall's head: a ring vessel with sixteen field coils, its bore dark.

cells.name: Precursor furnace
cells.description: A fullerene precursor furnace: its firebox west, two flue stacks east.

cells.name: Proof butt
cells.description: A range's proof butt: an earth berm faced on its south side with impact-pocked steel plate.
